parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A1 receptor in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Adenosine A1 receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
